item.title: JPMorgan concedes it closed Trump’s accounts after Jan. 6 attack
item.description: JPMorgan Chase now confirms it closed Donald Trump’s bank accounts after the Jan. 6 attack on the U.S. Capitol. The admission in a court filing is the latest development in a lawsuit over allegations of political “debanking."

item.title: NASA delays astronaut moon mission again after new rocket problem
item.description: NASA’s new moon rocket has suffered another setback, with astronauts’ lunar trip now off until spring.

item.title: Second avalanche in Big Cottonwood Canyon on Saturday leaves man injured
item.description: Just hours after an avalanche in Big Cottonwood Canyon left two men injured on Saturday, a second, unrelated avalanche left another man with non-life threatening injuries.

item.title: Former ‘American Idol’ contestant charged with murder, staging crime scene in wife’s slaying in Ohio
item.description: Authorities in Ohio have arrested a former contestant on “American Idol” and charged him with shooting and killing his wife and staging the crime scene to mislead investigators.

item.title: Man missing for nearly two weeks found dead in Grand County
item.description: A man who was missing for two weeks was found dead in Grand County Saturday morning.

item.title: ‘Stash house’ in Lehi raided by police, large quantity of narcotics seized
item.description: Police detectives in Lehi announced Saturday they had followed an anonymous tip to locate a 'stash house' in Lehi, leading to the seizure of a large quantity of drugs.

item.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as US beats Canada for gold at the Olympics
item.description: The U.S beats Canada 2-1 in overtime to win its first men’s hockey championship at the Olympics since 1980.

item.title: It’s a quiet box office weekend as ‘GOAT’ edges ‘Wuthering Heights’
item.description: It was a battle of the holdovers at the North American box office this weekend, with the family friendly film “GOAT” edging out the R-rated “Wuthering Heights.”

item.title: Verona prepares its ancient arena for the Olympics closing ceremony on Sunday
item.description: A city forever associated with Romeo and Juliet, Verona will host the final act of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics on Sunday inside the ancient Roman Arena, where some 1,500 athletes will celebrate their feats against a backdrop of Italian music and dance.

item.title: Avalanche in Snake Creek leaves snowmobiler missing
